about: Waiting at the bottom of the well: `wait` passes a minute and a half, waiting for the bucket an hour, in which the bucket comes down, and sleeping three hours, lowered to the host's hour, so the hourglass runs out only in the second sleep. Each command of a line has its time pass before the next runs.

expect.words: The bottom of a dry well. A rope runs up out of sight.
You haul on the rope, and the bucket rises out of sight.
You settle down to wait for the bucket.

expect.text: well_bottom.bucket woke, 1200 seconds after it asked

expect.words: The bucket comes back down the well, swinging.
You tip the hourglass, and the sand begins to run.
You curl up against the wall and sleep.
You curl up against the wall and sleep.

expect.text: well_bottom.hourglass woke, 5400 seconds after it asked

expect.words: The last of the sand runs out of the hourglass.
